svg.title: JH-Tiny-Test Skill Icon
svg.desc: Three silhouettes of Oree the duck, dressed in red, green, and blue, illustrate the iterative cycle of Test-Driven Development (TDD). Red represents a failing test, green marks a passing test, and blue signals refactoring, completing the familiar Red-Green-Refactor cycle.
svg.metadata:
Project: JH-Tiny-Test Project URL: https://github.com/JeongHan-Bae/JH-Toolkit
Purpose: A custom skill icon featuring three colorful silhouettes of Oree, the project's duck mascot, representing the three stages of the Test-Driven Development cycle.
Design: Three matching silhouettes of Oree arranged in red, green, and blue, each paired with a corresponding status symbol. Together, they illustrate the Red-Green-Refactor workflow: failing tests, passing tests, and improving code through refactoring.
